literal: please do not massage this part
reduce the pressure; the alt is the spoken form -- perlahan in this sense is Kamus Dewan's 'tidak dgn tenaga yg banyak', not the speed sense
this pressure is right; keep it like this
please massage especially the back -- belakang, not punggung, which in Malaysian Malay is the buttocks
please massage especially the neck; the alt names the nape, which is the part the trade works
